description: Retrieves a list of commits associated with a specific release version within a Sentry project.

inputSchema.description: Request schema for retrieving commits associated with a specific release in Sentry.

organization_id_or_slug.description: The unique identifier (ID) or human-readable slug of the Sentry organization to which the release belongs.
organization_id_or_slug.title: Organization Id Or Slug

project_id_or_slug.description: The unique identifier (ID) or human-readable slug of the Sentry project to which the release belongs.
project_id_or_slug.title: Project Id Or Slug

version.description: The version identifier of the release. This can be a commit SHA, a semantic version string, or any unique string identifying the release (e.g., 'my-app@1.0.0', 'cf7f4a337311e395e5099035f904289140b37025').
version.title: Version

inputSchema.title: RetrieveReleaseCommitsRequest

name: retrieve_release_commits

Commit.description: Individual commit object associated with a release.

dateCreated.description: ISO 8601 timestamp indicating when the commit was created.
dateCreated.title: Date Created

message.description: The commit message text (can be null).
message.title: Message

Commit.title: Commit

RetrieveReleaseCommitsResponse.description: Response schema for `RetrieveReleaseCommits`, containing the list of commits for the release.
RetrieveReleaseCommitsResponse.title: RetrieveReleaseCommitsResponse
